summary: This weekend strongly favors staying east of the Cascades. The top picks are the 2-Fast season finale at Oregon Raceway Park, Eastoberfest enduro in Spokane, Horn Rapids motocross, and a local Badger South 5K. Raging River's grand opening is a rare MTB event, but the current Snoqualmie Pass outlook turns cold and wet with possible snow Saturday, so it is a weather-dependent choice. Mad Meadows 50 is canceled due to the Little Giant Fire.

recommendations.title: 2-Fast Season Finale — Oregon Raceway Park
recommendations.location: Oregon Raceway Park, Grass Valley, OR
recommendations.weather: Cooler fall conditions; verify ORP forecast Friday
recommendations.description: 2-Fast's final motorcycle track weekend of 2026. Saturday runs ORP one direction and Sunday reverses it, with Performance School and coaching available.
recommendations.why: This is the last 2-Fast weekend of the season, close enough for a day trip or easy camp-over, and your SV650 is an obvious fit.

recommendations.title: Eastoberfest 2026 Enduro
recommendations.location: Beacon Hill / Camp Sekani, Spokane, WA
recommendations.cost: Registration shown open; verify fee with Evergreen
recommendations.weather: Cool fall riding; check Spokane forecast Saturday
recommendations.description: Evergreen East's multi-stage enduro at Beacon Hill. The course is released in advance and includes multiple stages, post-ride beverage, shirt, swag and prize drawings.
recommendations.why: Actual MTB racing within easy range and a better weather-side bet than crossing Snoqualmie Pass.

recommendations.title: Black Widow Fall Series — Rounds 3 & 4
recommendations.location: Horn Rapids Motorsports Complex, Richland, WA
recommendations.cost: $30 weekend gate; $45/class online or $50 track; transponder extra
recommendations.weather: Saturday forecast around upper 60s, low rain chance; good local dirt-bike weather
recommendations.description: Two full days of motocross racing at Horn Rapids. Camping is available and the series has adult classes plus year-end points.
recommendations.why: Your MX track is essentially next door and this is a race weekend rather than an ordinary practice day.

recommendations.title: Raging River Final Phase Grand Opening
recommendations.timing: Saturday, noon–5 PM; ribbon cutting 1 PM
recommendations.weather: Weather concern: Snoqualmie Pass outlook is cold/wet Saturday with possible snow at pass elevation
recommendations.description: Evergreen and DNR open Over & Out and Wild Waves, the final two descent trails in the decade-long Raging River build, with guided rides beginning after the ribbon cutting.
recommendations.why: A one-time milestone at a trail system you already want to ride, but only worth the drive if Friday's forecast and trail-status update improve.

recommendations.title: Middle Fork Trail Run — 50K / 22M / Half / 10K
recommendations.location: Middle Fork Snoqualmie, North Bend, WA
recommendations.weather: Likely cold and wet; nearby pass forecast deteriorates Friday/Saturday
recommendations.description: River-valley trail race with modest climbing relative to the distance: the 50K has about 4,090 ft. Online registration closes Thursday Oct. 8, with day-of registration available.
recommendations.why: A very relevant supported long-run option for your March 50-mile build, but the west-side weather keeps it below the east-side events.

recommendations.title: Badger South Prediction 5K
recommendations.timing: Saturday; choose start to finish at 10 AM
recommendations.weather: Around upper 60s Saturday with low rain chance
recommendations.description: A rolling paved prediction 5K: estimate your finish time and choose your own start so you arrive at 10:00 AM. Registration closes Oct. 8 at 11:59 PM.
recommendations.why: Cheap local speed work that leaves almost the entire weekend open for ORP, Horn Rapids or a long ride.

recommendations.title: Angels Rest 50K
recommendations.weather: Cool/wet transition possible by Saturday; verify Gorge forecast Friday
recommendations.description: A Columbia Gorge 50K with roughly 6,500 ft of climbing through waterfalls, forest and Gorge terrain.
recommendations.why: Harder and more mountain-specific than Middle Fork; excellent ultra training if registration and Friday's weather check both work.

recommendations.title: Kitsap Color Classic
recommendations.cost: Registration open; check current Cascade fee
recommendations.weather: Cool west-side fall weather; check Sunday rain forecast
recommendations.description: Cascade Bicycle Club's 2026 season finale: 52 miles and about 2,900 ft of climbing through Kitsap Peninsula roads.
recommendations.why: One of the last major organized road rides of the year, but the drive and west-side weather make it secondary this week.

recommendations.title: Loup Loup New Trails Work Party + Ride
recommendations.weather: Cold high-country fall conditions; check pass/forest forecast
recommendations.description: Evergreen lists an Oct. 10 New Trails at Loup Loup work party. It can be turned into a dig-and-ride day during larch season.
recommendations.why: Combines community, trail building and riding in an area that fits your north-central Washington adventure list.

recommendations.title: Pendleton Oktoberfest
recommendations.weather: Cool/dry eastern Oregon fall conditions expected
recommendations.description: The 10th annual Pendleton Oktoberfest at Blue Mountain Equine Center, with beer, German-themed festivities and community fundraising.
recommendations.why: Easy fallback if weather knocks out a bigger outdoor objective, and it pairs well with a Blue Mountains ride or hike.

recommendations.title: Mercer Fall Release Party
recommendations.location: Mercer Tasting Room, Walla Walla, WA
recommendations.cost: $30 guest; two complimentary for club members
recommendations.description: New estate releases, seasonal food and live music in downtown Walla Walla. Limited seating is advertised.
recommendations.why: A good evening layer after a Blue Mountains ride, run or local Saturday workout.

recommendations.title: Snyder Dock Waterski — Late-Season Window
recommendations.weather: Cool morning; Saturday forecast around upper 60s with modest wind signal
recommendations.description: Potential late-season local ski if the hourly wind forecast stays light enough at dawn.
recommendations.why: Very low logistics, but water/air temperature now makes this a weather-window activity rather than a default plan.

recommendations.title: Eastside Hills #196
recommendations.description: A 50-mile strenuous Cascade Bicycle Club ride at 20–22 mph on flats, using Juanita Drive, Winery Hill and other Eastside climbs.
recommendations.why: Pace and terrain fit your road fitness, but weather and drive make it a backup rather than a top pick.

recommendations.title: Ski / Avalanche Training — No strong weekend option yet
recommendations.description: The AIARE partner/event search did not surface a compelling PNW Level 1 course or webinar for Oct. 9–11. Keep this category on the weekly watch as winter approaches.
recommendations.why: Better to wait for a real PNW course than pad the list with irrelevant preseason offerings.

recommendations.title: Mountaineering — Weather-dependent shoulder season
recommendations.weather: Cascade weather deteriorates Friday/Saturday with cold precipitation at pass elevations
recommendations.description: No open Mountaineers event surfaced strongly enough to recommend over independent lower-elevation objectives this weekend. High-country conditions look less attractive than east-side riding/racing.
recommendations.why: The weekend pattern favors bikes and moto east of the crest rather than committing to a technical alpine objective.
